criteria.name: DA001
criteria.description:
核实EPA下载与格式页实际引用，准确说明日表/年表/技术说明的业务衔接。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA002
criteria.description:
三县FIPS与县原表身份校验正确，原始行号、日期键/重复/缺失/站点质量检查明确。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA003
criteria.description:
三县366日索引与缺测准确，不用0或年度数字补造逐日观测。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA004
criteria.description:
六档天数、Days with AQI及Max AQI逐县重算准确，与原始年表逐项对账并如实处理差异。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA005
criteria.description:
日历仅含三县2024周一至周五但含节假日，县日期唯一且无遗漏。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA006
criteria.description:
A>=101、B>=151的超标室内标记与101至150的B动作准确。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA007
criteria.description:
缺测一律待测室内备用，单独标记且不混入观测超标或两政策差异。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA008
criteria.description:
按县/月及总计的场次、差异和40×1.5潜在人时准确，日历可复算。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA009
criteria.description:
重点县月和A/B资源差异建议由真实汇总支持，可落实备用场地和活动方式。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA010
criteria.description:
不把回顾日AQI当实时预测、小时暴露或哮喘因果；明确监测覆盖、敏感人群和潜在非真实人时。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.

criteria.name: DA011
criteria.description:
三份精确命名产物可读，工作簿五表完整，CSV与备忘录/汇总关键数值一致。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
